retina_model: R1-R6 luminance-only. Column inferred from all contacts onto annotated L1/L2/L3; modal column. Experimental overlapping viewport projection, not calibrated retinal angles.
visual_dynamics: Photoreceptors and lamina are graded in vivo. This experiment uses an explicit LIF proxy, low-pass luminance drive and tonic lamina current; it is not validated fly vision.
motor_interface: Two fixed readout modes: biological-role comparison (DNa02 turn; DNp09/MDN motion; MN9 attack) and explicit visual-neuron BCI (DNp20 R-L turns; DNpe017 summed rate moves forward; DNpe017 spikes press attack). BCI gains are chosen engineering mappings, not natural fly behaviors. No aiming, target coordinates, auto-fire, stuck recovery, or game policy.
training: No synaptic plasticity. Optional score-contingent sugar input is stimulation, not learning.
displayNote: Subsample of measured soma locations. Every retained neuron and edge is simulated; the drawing is sampled.
